title: Parcelabot Property Report input
description: Provide a location to build a full property due-diligence report for. Use lat + lng, or a single 'lat,lng' location string. Set 'dryRun' first for a free preview of what the report would contain and how large it would be.

location.title: Location (lat,lng)
location.description: A single 'lat,lng' string aimed at a building or plot, e.g. '41.4036,2.1744'. In Google Maps, right-click the centre of a building's rooftop and copy the coordinates — a plaza, road, park or water has no cadastral parcel and returns no report.

dryRun.title: Free preview only (no report)
dryRun.description: Free. Returns what a report for this location would contain — the chapter list, how dense the local data is, and the estimated bytes/tokens for each output format — without generating or charging for a report. Needs coordinates; a cadastral reference alone cannot be previewed.

ref.title: Cadastral reference
ref.description: Alternative to a location: an exact cadastral reference. Spain (20-char RC, e.g. 8034006VP3183C0001IH), France (14-char IDU, e.g. 56005000AM0333) or Netherlands (kadastrale aanduiding, e.g. ASD40-C-7285). Takes priority over lat/lng and location.

country.title: Cadastre country (for ref)
country.description: Optional. Force which cadastre to use for an ambiguous 'ref'.

lat.title: Latitude
lat.description: Decimal latitude (WGS-84), e.g. '40.4168'. Use together with 'lng' as an alternative to 'location'.

lng.title: Longitude
lng.description: Decimal longitude (WGS-84), e.g. '-3.7038'. Use together with 'lat'.

format.title: Output format
format.description: 'json' (default) returns structured per-chapter facts — verdicts, numbers and sources — with no prose. 'markdown' returns the human-readable report. 'both' returns each.

detail.title: Detail level
detail.description: Applies to the JSON facts. 'full' includes every metric and source per chapter. 'brief' keeps only the verdict and headline per chapter — a fraction of the size when you just need a go/no-go read. Markdown output is unaffected.

chapters.title: Only these chapters
chapters.description: Optional. Limit the report to specific chapter slugs (e.g. 'flood-risk-snczi', 'seismic-zoning-ign'). Chapters that another chapter depends on are added automatically and reported back in 'chapters_auto_added'. Leave empty for the full report. Run with 'dryRun' to list the available slugs.

excludeChapters.title: Exclude these chapters
excludeChapters.description: Optional. Drop specific chapter slugs from the report.

includeImages.title: Include map images
includeImages.description: Off by default. Map images are large base64 PNGs — a single one can outweigh the entire text report. When on, they are written to the key-value store and referenced from the dataset record rather than inlined.

radiusKm.title: Preview search radius (km)
radiusKm.description: Optional, dry run only. Radius used when counting nearby points of interest.

persist.title: Store a copy on the Parcelabot server
persist.description: Ask the Parcelabot server to also persist the report for audit. Off by default — Apify already retains the result.

baseUrl.title: Parcelabot base URL
baseUrl.description: Override the Parcelabot host. Leave empty to use the default.

apiKey.title: Parcelabot API key
apiKey.description: Partner API key. Prefer setting the PARCELABOT_API_KEY environment variable (secret) on the Actor instead of passing it here.
